summary: Completed backend and frontend testing for LifeMicro app. All 19 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend onboarding, task generation, task completion, character creation, wallet, and shop tabs all functional. Fixed one bug: User ID was incorrectly using MongoDB ObjectId instead of UUID on duplicate device_id lookup.

fixed.issue: When returning existing user by device_id, was incorrectly setting id to MongoDB ObjectId instead of existing UUID
fixed.fix_applied: Removed line that overwrote id with _id, now properly returns existing UUID

issues: Goals count may show '0 selected' even when goals were clicked - possible state sync issue (not blocking)

console_warnings.warning: useNativeDriver not supported - Using JS-based animation fallback

critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding data-testid attributes to interactive elements for better E2E test stability
test_credentials: None required - app uses device_id for anonymous user creation
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates TEST_ prefixed users/data during test runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs all functional. Anti-cheat system works - must call POST /api/tasks/start before /api/tasks/complete for proper time tracking. Character creation works via POST /api/character/create. Trust score affects verification probability and reward multiplier. Frontend uses Expo/React Native with web support.

backend: POST /api/users - User creation with UUID generation ✓
POST /api/tasks/start - Task start for anti-cheat tracking ✓
frontend: Character tab with Create Character prompt ✓
